query:
SELECT e.id, e.nomeDoEquipamento, e.codigoTag, e.setorId, s.nome as setorNome, g.nome as grupoNome
FROM equipamentos e
LEFT JOIN setores s ON e.setorId = s.id
LEFT JOIN grupos_de_equipamentos g ON e.grupoId = g.id
WHERE e.id IN (19, 92, 43, 42, 39, 41, 6, 51, 58, 8, 9, 80, 82, 90, 50, 30, 29, 3, 22, 45, 79, 38, 37, 40, 10, 78, 91, 48, 52, 97, 87, 86, 94, 88, 93, 90001, 120060, 120059, 120006, 120017, 120018, 120025, 120036, 120042, 84, 120064, 120067, 120002, 120003, 120004, 120007, 120058)
ORDER BY e.nomeDoEquipamento
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40;
